name: Velocity Veil
description: Directional movement softness that smooths fast pans, zooms, rotations, and animated overlays.
author: ozonerepublic74d77777

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Controls the total blur distance in pixels.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: Sets the fallback blur direction when host motion vectors are unavailable.

parameters.name: Samples
parameters.description: Sets the number of texture samples used for the blur quality.

parameters.name: Position Influence
parameters.description: Controls how strongly positional movement contributes to the blur.

parameters.name: Scale Influence
parameters.description: Controls how strongly zooming or scaling contributes to the blur.

parameters.name: Rotation Influence
parameters.description: Controls how strongly rotation contributes to the blur.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Blends the motion-softened result with the original frame.
